other_failure_modes.name: Test set statistics used for feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes group-level statistics (e.g., mean, std) independently on the test set instead of computing them on the training set and mapping them to the test set. This causes the test features to depend on the test set's specific distribution and size, leading to inconsistent feature representations.

summary: The solution is generally very robust, employing a 5-fold stratified cross-validation strategy, appropriately adding external data only to the training folds, and optimizing ensemble weights using out-of-fold predictions. However, the agent calculates groupby statistics (like mean and standard deviation) independently on the test set rather than mapping the training set statistics, which can lead to distribution mismatches.
